equity.equity_measurement: Caregiver status is the exposure, not an SPD; SPD dimensions appear only as Table 1 composition, with no health estimates by race, sex or SES.

notes: Caregiving is the exposure, and the improved and worsened claims rest on age-adjusted logistic p-values, with t-tests used for Table 1 and unadjusted changes. Survey weighting produces every estimate, and age adjustment is regression, not direct standardization. The setting is coded subnational because the data cover 35 states and Puerto Rico, not a nationwide sample.
view_issues: Results say COPD and arthritis did not change, but Table 2 marks caregivers' unadjusted changes as significant (§§: COPD +0.9, arthritis +2.2, diabetes +1.7); the age-adjusted p-values (0.49, 0.36, 0.36) match the text.
